headline: The PTA, in collaboration with Meta, has blocked 176,000 WhatsApp accounts registered against recycled mobile numbers and agreed a permanent mechanism to share 5,000 recycled numbers with Meta every month, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Har mahine 5,000 recycled numbers Meta ko diye jayenge

caption:
176,000 WhatsApp accounts block kar diye gaye!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq PTA ne Meta ke saath mil kar recycled mobile numbers par register 176,000 WhatsApp accounts block kar diye hain, taake purane aur cancel SIMs ke zariye cyber fraud roka ja sake. Ab har mahine 5,000 recycled numbers Meta ko diye jayenge.
Kya aap ke saath kabhi WhatsApp fraud ki koshish hui? Comment mein batayein 👇
